title: Dynamical Kernel Attention: Estimating the Present from a Record of the Past
abstract: arXiv:2610.24026v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-attention encodes where a past token lies, but not how its uncertainty grows with time: evidence accumulates without bound as the context grows, and nothing indicates which tokens are safe to discard. We introduce Dynamical Kernel Attention (DKA), which derives attention from robust estimation of a latent state governed by a stochastic differential equation. Under this model, each head draws bounded evidence from any context. This lets each head abstain when relevant evidence is weak, and gives each head a memory window outside which discarding tokens changes its output by a provably bounded amount. On language modeling, DKA outperforms RoPE within the training length and ALiBi far beyond it, and matches sliding-window attention with a substantially smaller key-value cache.

translated_title: 动态核注意力：从过去记录估计当前状态
translated_abstract: 自注意力机制编码了过去词元所在的位置，但未能编码其不确定性如何随时间增长：随着上下文扩展，证据无界累积，且没有任何机制指明哪些词元可以安全丢弃。我们提出了动态核注意力（Dynamical Kernel Attention, DKA），它从由随机微分方程控制的潜在状态的鲁棒估计中推导出注意力机制。在该模型下，每个注意力头从任意上下文中提取的证据都是有界的。这使得每个注意力头在相关证据较弱时能够选择弃权，并为每个注意力头提供了一个记忆窗口——在窗口之外丢弃词元只会使其输出产生可证明的有界变化。在语言建模任务上，DKA在训练长度内优于RoPE，在远超训练长度的场景下优于ALiBi，并以显著更小的键值缓存达到了与滑动窗口注意力相当的性能。
tldr: 本文提出动态核注意力（DKA），从随机微分方程控制的潜在状态的鲁棒估计中推导注意力机制，使每个注意力头提取有界证据、在证据不足时弃权并拥有输出变化可证明有界的记忆窗口，在语言建模上优于RoPE和ALiBi，并以更小的键值缓存匹配滑动窗口注意力。
en_tdlr: Dynamical Kernel Attention (DKA) derives attention from robust estimation of a latent state governed by a stochastic differential equation, enabling each head to draw bounded evidence, abstain under weak evidence, and maintain a memory window with provably bounded output changes, outperforming RoPE and ALiBi on language modeling while matching sliding-window attention with a substantially smaller key-value cache.
